verdict.rationale: The maintained Smithery CLI says it connects agents to "thousands of skills and MCP servers", and Smithery remains a public MCP registry, so a deep catalog is still reachable. However, the hosted connection services (API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and keys) shut down on 2026-10-31, and the registry is now explicitly non-proxied, so the platform no longer hosts or brokers access to those integrations. Missing for 10: hosted or proxied access to the catalog after shutdown, managed OAuth for integrations post-shutdown, and independent verification of catalog size or depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
Smithery will remain as a public (non-proxied) MCP registry.
Smithery maintains OAuth apps for popular integrations.
